_comment: Built from the paper 'OCIA Sponsor Form' Holli provided.
The paper form leads with a page describing what a sponsor does (accompany,
pray, witness, believe, hope, love) before it asks anything. That framing is
kept here as the first step, because it is doing real work: it lets someone
decide they are not ready before they fill in twenty fields.
The paper form lists the parish phone as 509-574-2531. Every other parish
document uses 509-674-2531, so the correct number is used here.
A sponsor must be a confirmed Catholic in good standing and at least 16.
That is asked plainly rather than assumed.
title: OCIA Sponsor
successBody: Fr. Higuera or a member of the OCIA team will be in touch before sessions begin. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.

steps.title: What a sponsor does
steps.help: Read this first. If it is not the right year for you to take this on, that is a good thing to know now.

fields._comment: Reproduced from the paper form. Do not rewrite.
fields.html:
Accompany

  • Attend OCIA sessions weekly.
  • Inquire about the process.
  • Check in throughout the week.

Pray

  • Worship at Sunday Mass.
  • Commit to daily personal prayer.
  • Pray with your candidate.
  • Pray for your candidate.

Witness

  • Share your experiences.
  • Model an integrated Catholic life.
  • Live the joy of the Gospel.

Believe, hope, love

  • God is alive today and working miracles today.
  • Keep a heaven-based perspective and trust in the work God is doing.
  • Love God, love your candidate, and be willing to be poured out in service to both this year.

Sponsors are expected to attend all OCIA sessions and Rites with their candidates. Sessions are Thursday evenings at 6pm in the St. John the Baptist Parish Hall, Cle Elum.

Questions before you commit? Call Fr. Francisco Higuera at (509) 674-2531 ext. 5 or email Fr.higuera@yakimadiocese.org.

fields.label: I understand what is being asked and I am willing to commit to it for this year.

steps.title: A few requirements
steps.help: The Church asks these of every sponsor. If you answer no to any of them, send the form anyway and we will talk it through.

fields.label: Have you been baptized and confirmed in the Catholic Church, and received First Communion?
Are you currently attending Mass and living in full communion with the Church?
fields.help: This includes marriage being recognised by the Church, if you are married.

fields.html: Thank you for answering honestly. This is very often something that can be resolved, and it is worth a conversation. Please send the form and Fr. Higuera will follow up with you directly.

fields.label: Has a candidate already asked you to sponsor them?

options.label: No, please pair me with someone

fields.label: Which parish are you registered at?
Which parish?
fields.help: We will need a letter of good standing from them.

checks.message: Please give us at least one way to reach you: an email address or a phone number.

steps.title: Your own sacraments
steps.help: If you do not have the dates to hand, an approximate year and the church name are enough for us to request the record.

steps.title: In your own words
steps.help: Two questions. Answer them however you like, short or long.

fields.label: Why do you want to be a sponsor?
What do you enjoy most about being Catholic?

fields.html: May your faith rest not on human wisdom, but on the power of God.
